name: Personnal Extension
author: unknown
titleStrings: Amos 1.3 ET Amos Professionnal Personnal library

provenance.note: Distributed in a folder named 'Personal-1.1a' but the binary identifies itself as V1.0b and its own banner calls it the SHAREWARE demonstration version. The binary's self-report is taken as authoritative. Builds for both AMOS 1.3 and AMOS Professional.
provenance.redistribution: Shareware demonstration version; ships with the AMOS Professional source release.

notes: Full assembler source ships alongside the binary, so behaviour can be read directly rather than inferred — the only third-party extension here besides Intuition with source-grade evidence. No corpus program uses it, so the legacy id base is assumed rather than calibrated.
